blocks.content: Consistent revision and targeted practice of high-yield exam points are the keys to clearing competitive examinations.

items: Statement-based and multi-correct options are frequently used to test deep conceptual understanding.
Pay special attention to exceptions in rules, constitutional articles, and key historical chronologies.

blocks.title: Key Takeaways
items: Prioritize fundamental conceptual clarity over rote memorization for high-yielding syllabus sections.
Solve previous years' question papers (PYQs) systematically to identify recurring core themes.
Maintain structured short notes and memory aids for rapid pre-exam revision.
Focus on accuracy and elimination techniques to minimize negative marking in objective papers.
